lesson: Before plan approval, verify every MUST/SHALL FR in the spec is explicitly mapped to a task description or acceptance criterion; unmapped mandatory obligations fail traceability and block approval.
required_actions: run an obligation traceability check mapping every FR-### MUST/SHALL requirement to a task or acceptance criterion before submitting the plan for approval
verification_checks: confirm zero unmapped MUST/SHALL FRs in the final plan

lesson: When revising a plan, preserve the actual completion status of already-executed tasks; marking executed work as pending creates re-execution risk and reviewer rejection.
forbidden_actions: set already-executed tasks back to pending in a revised plan
required_actions: carry forward real task statuses (completed/in_progress) when saving plan revisions
verification_checks: compare revised task statuses against actual execution evidence before approval

lesson: Critic verdicts must be emitted in the exact machine-parseable format the gate recorder expects; prose-only approval summaries are lost when the session reverts, stranding an approved plan.
required_actions: emit verdict as strict JSON with an explicit verdict field (APPROVED/NEEDS_REVISION/REJECTED)
include reason and findings in structured fields, not only prose
verification_checks: confirm the persisted gate snapshot contains the verdict before reporting success

lesson: Treat a failure_revert with a positive critic summary as a persistence or format miss, not a content rejection; verify the mechanical snapshot before re-dispatching the critic.
required_actions: verify the gate evidence file contains the critic verdict before advancing the phase
verification_checks: gate snapshot exists and contains an APPROVED verdict
